Subject: only two characters. Aki is a short-haired young swordsman in a light tunic with a dark vest, carrying one plain sword. The gatekeeper is taller, wears dark armor and a simple mask, and carries one long spear. No other characters.

Text (verbatim): none. Absolutely no lettering, no Japanese characters, no speech balloons, no sound effects, no panel borders or captions.
